title: Gamerule 34
description: Simple mod that adds a commands who makes nearby animals breed
body:
Once you do the /gamerule34 command, all nearby animals of the same types will start breeding, don't pay attention to the error message, idk why it's Here, because the command works as intented. 

Note : You need to have the permissions to use thé command (cheats on) 

You get the exp

If there's too many mobs, they can not reproduce effectively 

 

Yeah..... Yeah.... I know. 

It's technically my first mod, but I do better things usually. At the beginning, I made that as a joke, and I thought to upload it, so Here we are. 🤣
